notes: Ruka 0.4.10: agent and local-model reliability. Editor subagents now run the acceptance command after each batch and stop as soon as it passes, instead of editing a passing test and breaking it. Edits outside the task's file scope are refused. Prompts are trimmed to the model context before every call, empty responses get one retry, text tool calls are parsed from plain JSON, fenced blocks, OpenAI-style payloads and JSON embedded in prose, and Ollama stream errors or missing final chunks now raise instead of returning partial text. An 8-task qwen2.5-coder:7b smoke run improved from 3/8 to 5/8; this is not a full baseline. 14/14 agent checks and 6/6 editor checks pass.
